verdict.rationale: Hummingbird offers customizable automation and workflows, but the workflows are set up by Hummingbird on the customer's behalf. Nothing in the evidence shows users can version, review changes to, or roll back automations. The audit trail covers work done in the product, and the review and approval features apply to cases rather than automation definitions, so both are adjacent capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
